# Neo Compute
> A provider-sourced GPU compute discovery and agent integration service.

Website: https://neo-compute.vercel.app
API discovery: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/api/capabilities
Main documentation: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/docs
Connect an agent: https://neo-compute.vercel.app/connect
Public SDK repository: https://github.com/trenchsheikh/neo-compute-public
OpenAPI 3.1: https://github.com/trenchsheikh/neo-compute-public/blob/main/openapi/neo-compute.yaml
MCP installation: https://github.com/trenchsheikh/neo-compute-public/tree/main/examples/agents

## What agents can do today
- Call GET /api/offers?gpu=H100 for supported model names.
- Check the connected flag before treating any result as a live provider quote.
- Read prices in USD per GPU-hour, or entire instance-hour separately.
- Run the open-source local Python MCP stdio server with search_compute and compare_compute tools.

## What agents cannot do today
- Neo does not offer remotely hosted MCP, payment signing, GPU rental booking, provisioning, or trading execution.
- Prices are provider-reported discovery data, not guaranteed orders.
- Do not attempt to provide cloud credentials or wallet private keys to the public API.
